Rina (PM): Heads-up: onboarding folks reported confusion — the in-app help panel on the Deployments page uses 'target' while our docs and API use 'destination'. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux-2001 :thinking:
Theo (Design): that mismatch explains a support ticket i saw. propose we standardize on 'destination' (clearer). i'll send a microcopy patch.
Jared (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'destination' already. can we add a canonical link in the panel pointing to /docs/deployments/destinations? that should reduce 'which doc is right' questions.
Pri (Frontend): note: CTA currently reads "Create target" and the panel header is "Target docs". these strings live in different components; small change but will need QA for saved deep-links.
Lena (A11y): accessibility notes: ensure the flyout's heading is programmatically announced and matches the docs link text. also avoid vague link text; use "Read destination docs (opens in new tab)". ensure focus is trapped and returned.
Theo (Design): microcopy proposal: CTA -> "Create destination"; panel title -> "Destination docs"; body -> "Destinations define where model traffic is sent. See examples and env var config in the docs." include small note: "Previously called 'target' in legacy UI."
Rina (PM): action items: Theo PR microcopy, Pri to update UI strings + add utm=console-help to link, Lena to validate aria & focus, Jared to update docs with a short legacy note. i'll open an RFC and tag #console for signoff.
Pri (Frontend): i'll coordinate QA and add a redirect mapping so old saved links don't break.
notify-bot: reminder set for #console-checkin Wed 09:30 to confirm rollout :bell:
Lena (A11y): will run VoiceOver/NVDA pass post-merge.
Rina (PM): target next patch. thanks team :sparkles:
